description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lutron Electronics is hiring an Embedded Software Engineer to contribute to smart lighting and shading products across the product lifecycle. The role involves developing software for connected systems and collaborating with cross-functional teams on design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Embedded software engineer gathering requirements, implementing, testing, deploying, and maintaining software components

Responsibilities:
• Eliciting software requirements from various stakeholders
• Participating in software design and implementation
• Testing, deploying, managing, and maintaining software components
• Participating in consensus-based software project management
• Prioritizing feature estimating
• Collaborating in reviews and demos

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science
• Minimum, cumulative GPA of 3.00 for each degree earned
• 0-3 years' experience in a related field
• You are authorized to work in the U.S. and will not require Lutron to sponsor you for any work visa, such as an H-1B, either immediately or at any time in the future
